name: Camera Detections
description: Connect one detection dataset from a JSON endpoint or local file, with independent credentials and update settings.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

provider.title: Data source
provider.description: Choose where this copy gets its data. Sample data lets you try the display before connecting a service.

cacheMs.title: Response cache · milliseconds
cacheMs.description: How long server responses are reused. 0 bypasses this response cache; a provider may also have its own refresh interval.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout · milliseconds
timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for an upstream response before showing an unavailable state.

url.title: JSON endpoint
url.description: Endpoint returning the documented JSON data format for this plugin.

path.title: JSON file path
path.description: Path on the Castboard server, relative to its configuration folder. In Docker, this must be a mounted path.

headers.title: Request headers
headers.description: Optional request headers as a JSON object. Saved values are hidden and never sent to displays.
